name: io.github.1solomonwakhungu/googlemcp
title: GoogleMCP
description: Local stdio MCP server for 19 Google APIs (Workspace, YouTube, GA4, Search Console, Photos).

packageArguments.description: Run the local stdio MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLEMCP_PRODUCTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Google product keys to enable (unset enables the 15 default products read-only).

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLEMCP_WRITE_PRODUCTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated enabled product keys (or 'all') granted non-destructive write tools and write scopes.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLEMCP_ALLOW_DESTRUCTIVE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to also expose destructive tools (delete, trash, send) for write-enabled products.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLEMCP_SECRET_BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: Secret storage backend for OAuth client credentials and refresh tokens.
